nominal_rationale: Fixed Gaussian position-noise condition for comparing weak and forward-difference estimators in the localized 10D benchmark.
pairing_policy: Within each repetition, all three estimators use the same latent trajectories, the same observed training array at sigma_obs=0.03, the same held-out latent test construction, and the same strong-form target subset. Weak LASSO and weak OLS use the same sampled weak training system.
failure_policy: Retain every repetition, nonconverged path candidate, boundary selection, rank deficiency, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric. Do not rerun to improve the result.
manuscript_policy: Report the fixed sigma_obs=0.03 condition and its estimator comparison; retain the clean-observation 10D results elsewhere as a separate baseline study.
